record.title: Instantiate the whole ADC programming candidate from captured state
record.intent: Turn the reviewed static grammar and observed software inputs into a typed complete operation sequence.
requirements: Decode the captured calibration record, shadows, selectors and runtime fields with explicit widths and signedness; bind raw and static source hashes and distinguish observed bytes from derived predictions.

Build a Kotlin typed operation sequence and TOML manifest for the selected mode-zero path, including all ordered writes, two readbacks, requested delays, masks, shadow transitions, helper status behavior and the routine return boundary.

Independently check the expected 97-write two-read 25200us branch against the reviewed grammar; use controls that detect wrong operands, ordering, signedness, missing operations and stale inputs rather than mirroring native implementation.
Mark read return words as unobserved hardware inputs and state their known software use; do not supply a new device response or claim acquisition. No guest execution in this task.
Record any input or control-flow ambiguity precisely. Commit and push the candidate and verification before considering dynamic validation.
acceptance: A complete independently checked candidate or a precise unresolved dependency is committed and pushed.
